items.raw_excerpt: 5月13日，联发科技在天玑开发者大会MDDC 2026上发布了天玑AI开发套件3.0，并展示了 将 阶跃星辰ACE-Step 音乐模型通过端侧可视化部署到天玑9500平台上，大幅度提升了模型及算法的移植效率。 基于此， 手机、汽车等终端领域品牌方，可以通过天玑AI开发套件，在天玑平台上快速为消费者打造极致的音乐生成产品体验。   据介绍，大模型端侧部署长期面临模型体积大、功耗高、移植周期长等工程挑战。 联发科技携手阶跃，通过天玑AI开发套件 3.0，实现了ACE-Step音乐模型在端侧的可视化部署。相较于传统 SDK，模型移植速度提升 50%，算法端侧移植效率提升 10 倍；相同质量下模型压缩率提升 58%；借助NPU 高能效特性，功耗降低 42%，有效降低设备运行时的发热与电量消耗。 ACE-Step 是阶跃与 ACE Studio 共同打造的音乐大模型，支持多种语言的歌曲生成，能力覆盖旋律生成、歌词撰写、人声合成、伴奏编排等创作环节，同时支持声线克隆、风格迁移、局部编辑等，为全球音乐创作者提供了更高效和灵活的创作工具。 此次端侧落地，是阶跃多模态大模型向"AI+终端"场景商业化延伸的重要进展。以此为基础，联发科技与阶跃星辰正携手推进跨端合作， 面向 手机与汽车两大场景，全面释放天玑AI能力，加速智能体应用规模化落地。

excerpt_i18n.en: On May 13, MediaTek released the Dimensity AI Development Suite 3.0 at the Dimensity Developer Conference MDDC 2026, and demonstrated the on-device visual deployment of the Stepfun ACE-Step music model on the Dimensity 9500 platform, significantly improving model and algorithm porting efficiency. According to reports, large model on-device deployment has long faced engineering challenges such as large model size, high power consumption, and long porting cycles. MediaTek, in collaboration with Stepfun, achieved the visual deployment of the ACE-Step music model on the device through the Dimensity AI Development Suite 3.0. Compared to traditional SDKs, model porting speed increased by 50%, algorithm on-device porting efficiency improved by 10 times, model compression rate increased by 58% under the same quality, and power consumption was reduced by 42% thanks to the high energy efficiency of the NPU, effectively lowering device heat generation and power consumption during operation. MediaTek, en colaboración con Stepfun, ha logrado superar estos obstáculos.

excerpt_i18n.en: Over the past year, the competitive logic of on-device AI has shifted. The focus of industry discussions is moving from whether models can run to whether capabilities can be continuously deployed, stably optimized, and truly integrated into the system's main path. Agent OS, system-native agents, cross-app execution, and on-device privacy protection—these once scattered technical keywords—are now converging toward a single direction: on-device agentification. What truly determines the next phase of competitive landscape is no longer just model parameter scale or chip peak computing power, but who can turn agent capabilities into a deployable, optimizable, and replicable engineering system. At the Dimensity Developer Conference (MDDC 2026), MediaTek sought to answer precisely this question. At the conference, MediaTek integrated the Dimensity AI development suite, system-native agent capabilities, and gaming technology system into a unified narrative. What it emphasized was no longer just chip performance, but how the Dimensity platform can serve as a truly usable on-device AI foundation for developers and a viable implementation base for system vendors. MediaTek Director, General Manager, and COO Chen Guanzhou stated: "Agent AI is reshaping and upgrading an increasing number of industries and application scenarios. MediaTek empowers the 'agentified experience' with a full-stack, diverse technology and product portfolio covering smartphones, automotive, IoT, and AI infrastructure, leveraging ubiquitous powerful computing power combined with advanced cloud AI acceleration technology to open up pathways for global ecosystem partners—from creativity to large-scale implementation, from application value to commercial success."
excerpt_i18n.es: El año pasado, la lógica competitiva de la IA en el lado del dispositivo ya ha cambiado. El enfoque de las discusiones en la industria está pasando de si el modelo puede ejecutarse a si las capacidades pueden implementarse de manera continua, optimizarse de forma estable y realmente integrarse en la ruta principal del sistema. Términos técnicos que antes estaban dispersos, como Agent OS, agentes nativos del sistema, ejecución entre aplicaciones y protección de la privacidad en el dispositivo, ahora convergen en una misma dirección: la agentización en el lado del dispositivo. Lo que realmente determinará el panorama competitivo de la próxima etapa ya no es solo el tamaño de los parámetros del modelo o la potencia máxima de cálculo del chip, sino quién puede convertir las capacidades de los agentes en un sistema de ingeniería desplegable, optimizable y replicable.
